cases.metric_definitions.txt:
lut_report.txt and vivado_resources.tsv contain exact native Vivado CLB LUT Used values for original mapped primitive subsets.
logical_lut_report.txt and logical_resources.tsv count logical primitive instances; LUT6_2 is one logical LUT primitive.
Native subset CLB LUT sums may differ from whole-design utilization because LUT combining can cross mapping boundaries.
fpga_io_cuts.txt counts canonical directed logical net destinations; clock/reset-only nets are classified separately.
io_cuts.txt is undirected hyperedge partition pairs, NOT package ports or physical links.
No wrapping, replication, transport insertion or physical link compression is modeled.
Topology costs are weighted shortest paths/Steiner routing costs, not measured link bandwidth or achieved DUT clock.
Path analysis is conservative primitive connectivity, not Vivado timing slack or a proof of Boolean sensitization.

The selected V5 k2/k3/k4 maps have completed original-source native validation and fresh exact-map full cut/category comparisons. Meaning of the reported quantities
H is the worst minimum-link-hop lower bound; C is the worst logical register-free boundary-crossing count. E is aggregate endpoint excess; V is transit primitives; T is the selected structural optimization transfer metric. Sampled STA is the objective over the same 1000 source timing paths, not routed FPGA delay or achieved Fmax. A cost of zero does not mean physical zero delay. H and C are separate measurements even when their values coincide.
Full comparison counts below are canonical electrical crossing nets and their distinct directed FPGA destinations, including clock/reset/top I/O. They are not package pin counts.
